candidate.title: RASL-Seq
candidate.scope: The single Illumina RASL-Seq schematic, also captioned A schematic overview of RASL-seq on the verified RNA collection page 11: poly(A)+ RNA -> targeted-probe annealing -> ligation -> displayed streptavidin selection -> probe elution -> indexed DNA library. RASL-Seq and RASL-seq are capitalization aliases for RNA-mediated oligonucleotide annealing, selection and ligation with sequencing. This is a targeted RNA assay whose sequenced carrier is ligated probe-derived DNA. The leftmost highlighted RNA/title graphic is a method emblem, not a separate material route. There are no depicted alternatives, splits or pooling branches. The Li/Qiu/Fu full-text protocol clarifies chemistry and readout; its capture-before-ligation order and probe-derived DNA product are stated explicitly where they differ from the cartoon. Unshown cell-lysate preparation, solid-support alternatives, related assays, kit listings and publication applications do not expand the target scope.

operations.label: Add targeted primers
operations.description: Add the two target-specific DNA probes to poly(A)+ RNA so that their complementary targeting regions align adjacently on the RNA. operations.mechanism: Sequence-complementary hybridization; the P and OH at the probe junction distinguish reactive DNA ends from the separately labelled RNA 5′OH.
operations.information_effect: Probe choice restricts the assay to predefined transcript regions or splice junctions. RNA alignment associates two reporter halves with a target; no sequence information is copied into cDNA at this step.

operations.label: Ligate
operations.description: Join the adjacent RNA-aligned DNA probe pair into one continuous reporter while the RNA and poly(A)/oligo(dT) duplex remain present. operations.mechanism: The primary implementation uses T4 DNA ligase to join the phosphorylated 5′ probe end to the adjacent probe 3′ hydroxyl; RNA acts as the alignment template, not as the joined product.
operations.information_effect: A successful ligation makes a single DNA reporter carrying both target recognition regions and both universal handles. Incorrect/random probe ligations can still occur.

evidence.quote: RNA-mediated oligonucleotide annealing, selection, and ligation with next-generation sequencing (RASL-Seq) is a 2-dimensional RNA sequencing method to quantify expression profiles of several hundred genes, under thousands of different conditions.
